anomaly_source: DTD R1.0.1 with frozen content-disjoint train/dev split

synthetic_development_contract.p_ap_prevalence_note: P-AP is specific to the frozen 1:2 development prevalence.

claim_boundary: Synthetic development performance selects and debugs a method; it is not evidence of performance on real defects.

matrix.purpose: Validate data, logging, checkpoint and metric plumbing only.

matrix.budget: same full development schedule later used by candidates
matrix.purpose: Freeze the development reference without formal test access.

matrix.method_definition_rule: Each candidate config and hypothesis must be frozen before its first run.
matrix.budget: identical to S1 per category; at most 8 hyperparameter configurations per candidate family
matrix.purpose: Bounded selection on frozen synthetic development data.
Confirm development stability before any formal test evaluation.
Establish component attribution on development data.

matrix.entry_gate: All implementation, hyperparameters, checkpoints, thresholds, table schemas and visualization selection rules are frozen; the fixed-sample manifest is generated from the complete test inventory before model inference.
matrix.purpose: One formal evaluation pass; no result-driven redesign in the same registered round.

formal_claim_rules.required_dataset_direction: candidate macro mean must exceed DRAEM separately on both MVTec AD and VisA
formal_claim_rules.ci_rule: category-level paired 95% bootstrap lower bound must exceed zero on at least one dataset; the other dataset must retain a positive point estimate
formal_claim_rules.strong_control_boundary: A passed DRAEM comparison supports only a DRAEM-improvement claim. If the candidate does not beat PatchCore or RD4AD under the common protocol, that result must be reported and best-overall or SOTA claims are forbidden.
formal_claim_rules.failed_rule_policy: report the complete registered matrix and downgrade or reject the corresponding improvement claim

formal_method_registry.freeze_rule: Replace null values and set status=frozen_before_formal_evaluation before any F0 inference or aggregation.

stopping_rules: Stop a candidate family after its first registered-seed all-category screen if macro AUPRO is at least 0.5 percentage point below baseline.
Stop a candidate family if more than two categories regress by more than 3.0 percentage points on the primary development metric.
Stop development after three candidate families or eight hyperparameter configurations per family, whichever limit is reached first.
Do not replace a stopped candidate using any observation from formal test data.
Any formal test access before F0 invalidates this registered round and must be disclosed; start a new registration before further development.
After F0, report all registered seeds and categories. Further model changes belong to a new exploratory round.
